args.message: Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money, per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, which broke the nightly build: `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212.

## Change
- Import `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP` and use it in `round_money`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212` (sha `08d3cd5986`): **passed**.
  - `test_half_even` now passes: `2.675 → 2.68`, `2.665 → 2.66`.
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212
args.title: Fix banker's rounding in round_money (FIN-212)

transcript.reasoning_content:
The docstring already says banker's rounding but uses ROUND_HALF_UP. Fix: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

Check: 2.675 quantized to 0.01 with ROUND_HALF_EVEN — careful: Decimal("2.675") is exact, so half-even rounds to 2.68 (since 2.67 vs 2.68, tie; last digit 7 → round to even → 2.68). Test expects 2.68. Good. 2.665 → tie between 2.66 and 2.67 → even → 2.66. Good.

Create branch, commit, run CI.
